noticias.titulo: Nasdaq jumps as Nvidia revenue outlook lifts chip stocks
noticias.resumo:
Outside of Nvidia and its fellow chip stocks, Salesforce rallied 21% after revenue came in ahead of Wall Street's forecast for the second quarter.  Software stocks such as Adobe and Autodesk climbed around 6% each. 

Within cybersecurity, Okta soared more than 27% and CrowdStrike gained 18% after surpassing analyst expectations and raising their outlooks as the companies see booming demand due to agentic AI.
